    shape = cq.Workplane('XY').box(self.length, self.width, self.height)
    self.box = shape
    self.model = shape

description: Adds a two-groove wheel with pointy sides and a flat middle section with a smaller radius.

def add_wheel(self):
    # Create the profile of the wheel to revolve
    # The profile is a polygon in the XZ plane, which will be revolved around the Z axis
    # The wheel is centered at the origin, so we'll translate it later
    
    r_outer = self.wheel_radius
    r_inner = self.middle_radius
    w_total = self.wheel_width
    w_flat = self.middle_flat_width
    w_groove = self.groove_width
    
    # Calculate points for the profile
    # Starting from bottom center (0, -w_total/2)
    pts = [
        (0, -w_total/2),
        (r_outer, -w_total/2),
        (r_outer - self.groove_depth, -w_flat/2 - w_groove/2),
        (r_inner, -w_flat/2),
        (r_inner, w_flat/2),
        (r_outer - self.groove_depth, w_flat/2 + w_groove/2),
        (r_outer, w_total/2),
        (0, w_total/2)
    ]
    
    wheel = cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline(pts).close().revolve(360, (0,0,0), (0,1,0))
    
    # Position the wheel on the side of the box
    # The box is centered at origin, so the side face is at X = length/2
    wheel = wheel.translate((self.length/2 + w_total/2, 0, 0))
    
    self.model = self.model.union(wheel)
